name: EDA
purpose: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) solves the problem of understanding raw data before formal modeling or hypothesis testing. It helps identify errors, uncover hidden patterns, detect outliers, and reveal relationships within the data. This process is crucial for ensuring data quality, guiding feature engineering, validating assumptions, and enabling stakeholders to ask pertinent questions, ultimately leading to more robust models and informed business decisions.
keyCapabilities: Assess data quality, including missing values, errors, and inconsistencies.
Discover underlying patterns, trends, and relationships between variables.
Identify outliers and anomalous events within the dataset.
Generate hypotheses for further statistical analysis or predictive modeling.
Prepare and transform data for machine learning and advanced analytical techniques.
useCases: Customer segmentation and profiling to refine marketing strategies.
Market basket analysis to understand product relationships and optimize sales.
Anomaly detection for fraud prevention or identifying equipment failures.
Predicting business trends and optimizing operational strategies.
Feature selection and engineering for machine learning model development.
